activity_summary: At dinner you ate Friday fish at the lodging. The board was threepence. The penny loaf was still a finger short, and no second was bought. Fair Em was at the Cross Keys, and you were not in it. You told them the letter went yesterday. You did not send anyone out to a bill.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ate, and did not go out.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Served the fish and kept the girl in the house.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Named the short loaf and asked after the letter.

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: A finger short of the notch, sir.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: There is no rehearsal tomorrow until nine.
